QuestInfo.name: The Remnants of Horntail...
QuestInfo.0: After defeating Horntail, I was able to acquire Nine Spirit's Egg. I better take it to Nine Spirit's nest and see what happens.
QuestInfo.1: As soon as you returned the Nine Spirit's Egg to the nest, the egg hatched and out came a baby dragon.
QuestInfo.2: After returning Nine Spirit's Egg onto\nits nest, the baby dragon hatched from the egg. As soon as the dragon emerged, it coughed for a little bit, and spat out #b#t2041200##k.
